Orezi (real name Esegine Allen), the Nigerian dancehall artist, was born in **Owhelogbo, Isoko, Delta State**, Nigeria.

According to recent information (including references for the 2026/2027 Legal Year), the current **Chief Judge of Delta State** is **Honourable Justice Tessy O. Diai** (also known as Justice Theresa T. Obiajulu Ogochukwu Diai). She took office around May 2021 and continued serving through 2025 into the 2026 legal year, with official acknowledgments confirming her leadership role during the new legal year celebrations.
